purpose: Current available action context, selective rehydration and retirement.
use: Every interaction and before governed effects: keep the needed closure loaded, rehydrate stale context and follow runtime guidance and declaration (R27).
semantic_conditions: Compaction, route change or identity change invalidates affected context until verified again.
mandatory_preconditions: Current route, closure identities and context integrity state.
postconditions_verification: Only valid context reused; stale or missing context rehydrated before dependent effects.
